about: What a scoped @http or websocket endpoint answers a caller its scope does not include (S-242/S-243, 2026-09-25). An endpoint with no scope, or `all`, is open and never answers these. Both SDKs check their servers against this file: Python tests/server/test_endpoint_scopes.py, TypeScript tests/unit/server/endpoint-gate.test.ts.

error.message: This endpoint needs a caller this agent can verify, and the request carries none.
This endpoint is not open to this caller.
